response.sql: SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_rental_rate_per_duration FROM film f WHERE f.replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY f.rating

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 20.99 is inclusive (≥), so films with replacement_cost equal to or greater than 20.99 are considered expensive

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive (>), so only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 are expensive
